faq.lasts.q: How long does a fragrance last?
faq.lasts.a: It depends on the concentration and your skin: Eau de Toilette - 3-5 h, Eau de Parfum - 5-8 h, Parfum - 8 h or more. Every product page describes the notes and character of the fragrance.
faq.choose.q: How do I choose without smelling it?
faq.choose.a: Start with ‘Find your fragrance’ (3 questions) or our 2 ml samples.
faq.return.a: For hygiene reasons we can only accept perfume that is unopened, in its original packaging with the cellophane intact, within {n} days. That's why we suggest starting with a sample.
faq.ship.q: When will my order be dispatched?
faq.ship.a: Within {d} of payment. Once it's on its way, we'll email you the tracking number - you'll also find it in your account.
faq.account.a: No - you can check out as a guest. With an account you'll see your order history, delivery status, favourites and discount codes.
faq.gift.a: Yes - select ‘Gift wrapping’ in your bag (+{price}) and add a message if you like. No price receipt is included.
faq.gift.aNo: Just email us and we'll wrap it for you.

help.paymentText: By card, Apple Pay or Google Pay - securely via Stripe. We never see or store your card details. You can enter a discount code on the payment page. All prices include VAT.
about.title: About us
about.p1Text: Every fragrance is available as a 2 ml sample.
about.p2Text: We describe how a fragrance smells and feels - not just a list of ingredients.

reviews.sub: Only customers who have bought from us can leave a review - via the link we send after purchase, or in their account. We publish every review that meets our guidelines and never edit them.
